title: Edit profile saves a half-typed mobile number as if it were complete
what: The mobile number box in Edit profile saves as you go. Its check accepts any 7 to 15 digits, so a member who stops after 7, 8 or 9 digits of an Indian number (no + in front) sees 'Saved' and no error. The box's own cleaning treats a number without + as Indian, so that value can never be a real mobile. Find my gym later fills its box with this short number.
expected: A number without a + in front must have all 10 digits before it is saved, the same rule as every other mobile box; otherwise the box says 'enter 10 digits'.
how_often: when a member leaves the box before typing all 10 digits
fix_line: Use the 10-digit Indian check for numbers without a plus sign; keep the any-country check only for numbers that start with a plus

items.reason: Crispy Curves fill counts (field-fill.csv): birthday 1/2, member phone 2/2, check-in phone 1/2, app link 0/2, plan start 1/1, plan end 1/1, trainer 0/2, batch 0/2. Of the 30 features in this area only three touch a member field: Edit profile (the member's own mobile, kept on the phone, not countable in the database), Join your gym and Leave my gym (the gym link, not the member record's app link). None reads birthday, plan dates, trainer or batch.

The mobile number is asked in Edit profile (optional) and at check-in when the gym needs it (phone sent only when just typed). Joining by code or poster asks no number and sends none; that gap is already recorded.

Check-in phone is filled for 1 of 2 Crispy Curves members and the app link for 0 of 2; the app's own number never reaches the gym (existing finding). No other feature here depends on a mostly-empty field.

Ran the shared cleaner on 14 real shapes (+91 with spaces, +919876543210, 0 in front, dashes, brackets, 0091, Hindi digits, +91 with Hindi digits, trailing space, 91 without plus, +1 and +44 foreign, 11th digit typed, paste over a full box): every Indian shape ends as the right 10 digits, foreign numbers are kept whole. No mobile box has a length limit. Age (3) and height (5) limits fit real values. Gym code boxes clean pastes and links (and the server upper-cases and trims). Cloud email is trimmed before sign-in. The one fault: Edit profile saves a short number.
No box in this area cuts or refuses a real autofill or paste: the phone boxes carry no length limit and clean country codes, spaces, dashes and other-script digits.
